title: lupinus perennis var. gracilis
intro: Lupinus perennis var. gracilis, commonly known as the woodland lupine, is a perennial legume native to eastern North America. This plant has been used for its medicinal properties, which include health benefits such as reducing inflammation, improving cardiovascular health, and boosting the immune system. The therapeutic actions of Lupinus perennis var. gracilis include its antimicrobial, antispasmodic, and anti-inflammatory properties, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins. The bioactive constituents of this plant, particularly quinolizidine alkaloids, have been shown to exhibit antioxidant and anti-inflammatory activities.
